name: h05-no-code-fails-silently
note: 'if no code exists at HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS, the call must fail silently' -- the run still succeeds, charges nothing, and writes nothing. Measured this round against both pinned binaries: `bin/evm-v1.15.0` and `bin/evm-v1.14.0` each exit 0 with gasUsed 0x0, stateRoot 0x517f2cdf6adb1a644878c390ffab4e130f1bed4b498ef7ce58c5addd98d61018 and a post-state holding only the sender at 0xde0b6b3a7640000 -- so the case is coverage either way, not a Prague/Cancun discriminator. `gasUsed` is the observable consequence: it is scored by `t8ncheck.py` without any `--check` flag, so a tool that charges the system call as a real call (or, having found no code, aborts) reports a non-zero total and fails. The `alloc` key the round-3 finding asked for is deliberately NOT declared: `prague_probe.sh` does not pass `--check alloc`, and adding that flag would resurrect `t8ncheck.py`'s legacy vocabulary on `r02`, whose whole assertion is that `stateRoot` is absent -- the probe set's other half. The `storage` key stays for the same reason the doc clause is here: it pins the address to absent-and-unwritten rather than to a wrong value.
